svg.title: Swimming instructor — Man
svg.desc: A fictional man working as swimming instructor, wearing a sports top. Visible work cue: Swimming goggles sit above a rounded training kickboard and a clearly separate water ripple. The person is on the right, with the work cue on the left. Appearance: long hair, a softly squared face.
